description: Top comments (up to 15) on one Instagram post or reel, TikTok video or YouTube video, each labelled positive, neutral or negative, with a sentiment score, themes, a one-line summary, questions asked and top emojis. Use for social listening: what people say about a post, a product launch, a creator or a competitor's video. Reads comments in any language, including Hinglish and romanised Nepali. Returns summary {comments, sentiment {positive, neutral, negative, score -1..1}, method (model or rules), themes[], summary, questions, topEmojis[], avgLikes} and comments[] {author, text, likes, replies, date, sentiment}. Cached 12 hours by default. Posts with no public comments fail and are not charged. Price: $0.05 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails.
